_doc: Result-change notices: one per (slug, outcome) whose served pooled result changed. before/after are the served and the rebuilt result tuples (k, estimate, ci_low, ci_high) read from the review objects; left_pool/entered_pool name every trial that moved; the honest ratchet refuses a landing whose result differs from the served one without an exact notice; the page renders each notice beside the outcome and names a reversal of significance as a withdrawal of the previous conclusion. reviewer_countersignature: OPEN until the reviewer has SEEN the rendered notice; SEEN_AND_SIGNED (per notice; the only signature a withdrawn conclusion accepts) or BATCH_SEEN_AND_SIGNED (direction-preserving changes, batch_id named) carry by, when_utc, the sha256 of the rendered block that was signed, and how_it_reached_the_reviewer (the rendered block itself, or a relay and what the relay conveyed); there is no 'agreed in advance'.

notices.reason: CORP-2 (PMID 24694983) is now pooled from its own arm counts, 26/120 vs 51/120 (RR 0.51, 95% CI 0.34-0.76), instead of the printed 'relative risk 0.49; 95% CI 0.24-0.65'. That figure is the relative risk REDUCTION: 1 - (0.51, 0.76, 0.34) = (0.49, 0.24, 0.66), printed under the label 'relative risk' in the same sentence as the counts. Mechanism: harness/design_key.ratio_label_audit (V1.0.1 acquisition cascade) -- a printed ratio outranks the same source's counts only if it agrees with them; a ratio that matches the 1-x reading with a flipped interval is refused as MISLABELLED_RRR. A ratio that fits neither reading is kept (it may be adjusted), not guessed. Trial membership is unchanged. The previously served result is superseded, not refuted: the numbers are not asserted wrong, and any trial set aside or not yet admitted stays eligible evidence awaiting adjudication.
notices.by: Claude Opus 5.5 (lane evid/v1.0.1-acquisition-cascade, 2026-09-27); reviewer countersignature owed: Mahmood
